permissions.see_country: Always display the country of the IP address

general.heading: General Settings
general.help: These settings control the general behavior of the extension.

providers.heading: IP Lookup Service
providers.help: Choose a service to use for IP lookups. Some services have rate limits, so be sure to check the service's documentation for more information.

settings.service_ipdata_description: Use https://ipdata.co to make up to 1,500 lookups daily for free. Paid plans for higher usage limits are also available.
settings.service_ipapi_description: Use http://ip-api.com to make up to 45 lookups per minute for free. If you make more, requests will be queued and looked up once the time window resets.
settings.service_ipapi-pro_description: Use https://members.ip-api.com/#pricing. Pro plan has unlimited usage.
settings.service_iplocation_description: Use https://www.iplocation.net/ to retrieve country and ISP data. Lookup rate limits are unknown.
settings.service_ipsevenex_description: Use https://7x.ax to get a free API key for up to 20 requests per minute. Paid plans for higher usage limits are also available.
settings.service_ipinfo-lite_description: Use https://ipinfo.io to retrieve IP information without any rate limiting or restrictions. Requires registration for a free API key.
settings.service_maxmind_description: Look up addresses in local MaxMind-format (.mmdb) databases instead of calling a remote API. Works with MaxMind's GeoLite2/GeoIP2 and DB-IP's Lite editions. Lookups are instant, unlimited and never leave your server, but you must install and update the database files yourself. See https://github.com/FriendsOfFlarum/geoip for examples.
settings.service_forced: The lookup service is set to {service} by an extender, so it cannot be changed here.
settings.service_unavailable: The selected lookup service is not usable, so no IP information is being recorded. For offline databases, check that at least one database path below is set and points to a readable .mmdb file.
settings.databases_help: Absolute paths to your .mmdb files. All three are optional and independent — the country database alone is enough for country flags, city adds coordinates for the map, and ASN adds the ISP and organisation. Note that DB-IP's Lite editions contain no postal codes, and no offline database contains threat data.
settings.setting_pinned: Set by an extender, so it cannot be changed here.
settings.show_flag_label: Show country flag for each post
settings.show_flag_help: Without disclosing the IP address, show the country flag of the IP address of the post author, when the user opts in via their preferences.
settings.allow_custom_flag_label: Allow users to choose a custom country flag
settings.allow_custom_flag_help: When enabled, users can pick a country flag to display on their posts via their profile settings. A user-selected flag is shown to everyone and takes precedence over the IP-based flag. Requires "Show country flag for each post" to be enabled.

test.heading: Test Service Configuration
test.help: Test your IP lookup service configuration with a sample IP address. Make sure to save your settings first before testing.

settings.test_service_help: Enter an IPv4 or IPv6 address to test your current service configuration.
settings.test_ip_required: Please enter an IP address to test.
settings.test_error: An error occurred while testing the service.

map_modal.title: IP Information
map_modal.not_enough_data: Not enough data to draw a map

settings.ip_country: Show the flag of the country I post from, based on my IP address
settings.custom_flag_help: Choose a country flag to display on your posts. This flag is visible to everyone and is shown instead of the flag based on your IP address.

settings.showIPCountry: Show the flag of the country the user posts from
settings.showIPCountry-help: This is based on their IP address at the time of posting. The country flag (if enabled) will be visible to all users. Admin users and moderators will see the IP address in the tooltip.
